name: Kodama Hibiki
source:
A girl who [url=/c7874]Shougo[/url] bumped into on the street. She's longing to something gorgeous. A teenage [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freeter]freeter[/url] like [url=/c11644]Shin[/url]. She doesn't go to high school but has has a part-time job to make a living. She's very true to her feelings. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_that_became_a_Memory_~Memories_Off~]Wikipedia[/url] and partly translated from the [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/omokimi/chara.html]Official Site[/url].]
